items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: We were working out with Lou Armstrong. We were working down in the Cotton Club when that happened - '39.

ctx.x: Right. Do you know approximately when you left Fletcher Henderson's band?
... You left Lou Armstrong and went with Red Allen. I know he was with Lou Armstrong in 1936. Then I came to Cleveland in 1938 and you were still with Lou Armstrong. I mean I came to New York.
Could you approximate when he left Fletcher Henderson?
